authors: Daoyu Wang; Mingyue Cheng; Zhiding Liu; Qi Liu
independent_acceptance: focused scientific check completed; scientific adjudication pending

problems.title: Dropped timestep weights invalidate exact ELBO equivalence
problems.claim_location: Section3.2 p5 Eq11; Appendix C.3 p17 Eqs27-31
assumptions: Reverse mean parameterized using clean-data prediction and posterior affine coefficients
Cosine T=1000 offset .008 schedule; s=2,500 have positive variances
problems.check: Complete Gaussian square and compute w_s=baralpha_(s-1)*beta_s/[2*(1-baralpha_s)*(1-baralpha_(s-1))]. Independent schedule evaluation gives w2=6391.915 and w500=.00305099.
problems.result: Unweighted error is not the equal-variance Gaussian KL sum up to a common multiplier.
problems.counterevidence: Unweighted simplified objective can be useful; different variance or sampling would be different assumptions. No empirical failure claimed.
problems.impact: Invalid central mathematical justification, not proof that training is ineffective.

correction.statement: Retain w_s on each clean-data squared error under specified posterior-mean parameterization.
correction.scope: Intermediate KL only; endpoint and reverse-model specification still required.

independent_check.original_and_assumptions: Read p.5 Eq.11 and p.17 Eqs.25-31; independently viewed p.17. The equal-covariance premise is explicit before Eq.29. Fixing autoregressive context does not remove timestep dependence.
independent_check.independent_derivation: For s>=2, posterior precision alpha_s/beta_s+1/(1-baralpha_(s-1)) gives variance beta_s*(1-baralpha_(s-1))/(1-baralpha_s). The x0 coefficient is sqrt(baralpha_(s-1))*beta_s/(1-baralpha_s). Squaring that coefficient and dividing by twice the variance gives the report weight. A fresh standard-library math calculation of normalized cos^2((s/1000+.008)/1.008*pi/2), without importing author code, returned s=2: beta=4.614175273665033e-05, variance=2.178949614569182e-05, slope=.5277814093344871, weight=6391.915035037939; s=500: beta=.0031458862304780677, variance=.003136199904057811, slope=.004374588226145536, weight=.003050988893209657. All variances positive.
independent_check.counterevidence_and_scope: An unweighted surrogate may share the unconstrained infinite-capacity optimum and be empirically better, but it is not the displayed KL identity for shared model parameters. Different variance or importance sampling can alter weights; actual frozen lines135-150 and loss lines179-180 use the stated schedule, uniform timesteps and plain MSE. Endpoint terms remain excluded.
independent_check.severity_and_repair: Major retained for the central exact-ELBO derivation, not a claim of failed representation learning. Restoring intermediate weights is only a conditional identity repair; full reverse-model and endpoint specification remain open.

problems.title: Released global flatten head contradicts patch-local reconstruction
assumptions: Frozen commit e658a648cf6b04612ca643d10a634b45e136194c original TimeDART forecasting pretrain path
Dense layer allows arbitrary off-block coefficients
problems.check: Independent two-feature dense linear head with W12=1 makes output1 depend on later feature2. Same allowed submatrix in full layer.
problems.result: Attention masks do not enforce patch-local output dependence after dense head.
problems.counterevidence: ARFlattenHead exists but selected call commented out; learned off-block zeros possible; experiment commit unknown.
problems.impact: Release-specific substantive correspondence issue; no demonstration of corrupted historical results or test-target leakage.

correction.statement: Use enforced patch-local/block-diagonal output head to eliminate this path.
correction.scope: Does not repair raw-coordinate causality through whole-window normalization.

independent_check.original_and_assumptions: Read original p.4 Eqs.7-8 and directly inspected frozen repository models/TimeDART.py lines20-42,113-133,175-197. FlattenHead is selected in pretrain and ARFlattenHead is commented out.
independent_check.independent_derivation: The linear map has input dimension seq_len*d_model and unrestricted weights. With two scalar blocks and W=[[0,1],[0,0]], output1 is feature2; changing feature2 from3 to4 changes output1 while feature1 is fixed at2. This dependency persists regardless of an upstream causal/self-only attention mask. No model import or author execution occurred.
independent_check.counterevidence_and_scope: A learned zero off-block matrix is possible but not enforced. Raw-window normalization creates separate dependencies, and the historical experiment commit is unknown. No held-out forecasting-target leakage or measured performance damage is established.
independent_check.severity_and_repair: Minor retained for release-to-formula correspondence. A block-local output head removes this particular path; it does not certify raw-coordinate causality or restore historical results.

repair_verification: Weighted intermediate KL formula only; no retraining or full reverse-model repair.
